title: bot.ability.vocal.speech.encoding.output
description: Encoded speech (mosfet's SpeechEncoding output, the audio bytes; floppy passes media by reference, with its format).

audio.description: Reference (a URI reference) to the encoded audio the speech service wrote; floppy passes media by reference, never as bytes [floppy field].
audio.title: Audio

media_type.description: Media type of the encoded audio (e.g. audio/pcm, audio/wav) [floppy field].
media_type.title: Media Type

sample_rate_hz.description: Sample rate of the encoded audio in hertz, when known [floppy field].
sample_rate_hz.title: Sample Rate Hz

channels.description: Channel count of the encoded audio, when known [floppy field].
channels.title: Channels

duration.description: Seconds of sound the audio makes, measured from its bytes when the form is linear PCM (mosfet's Speaking playout duration), else null [floppy field].
duration.title: Duration
